lines.text: The Spirit of the LORD came upon Jephthah, who vowed to offer whatever came out his door as a burnt offering.
The LORD delivered the Ammonites into Jephthah's hand, and he devastated twenty cities with a great blow.
Jephthah returned home to Shiloh, and his only child, his daughter, came out to meet him with tambourines.
Jephthah tore his clothes, but his daughter asked for three months in the mountains with her friends, and he sent her.
After two months she returned, he did to her as he had vowed, and young women lament her four days each year.
